newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest shares extend gains in active trading.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest shares extend gains in active trading.

text.p: The bulk of Bucharest share prices closed higher on Tuesday in active buying, which also pushed up volumes and turnover.
"Buying pressure persisted, but was weaker than yesterday and I think the correction we've all been waiting for is elbowing its way into the market," said a trader.
The closing quotes of 22 stocks rose, while five companies closed weaker and seven stayed flat. Nine stocks had no trade and two were suspended.
Volume climbed to 4.1 million shares from 2.6 million on Monday and turnover was five billion lei up at 16.4 billion.
Two independent market indices, the VAB and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, reached new highs, rising by 1.1 and 1.07 percent respectively from Monday.
Traders said investors had kept their focus on first-tier stocks, with that section taking 80 percent of turnover.

Oltchim chemical plant and fertiliser maker Azomures were the most heavily traded of the seven high-caps. Azomures closed 50 lei stronger at 3,900, while Oltchim lost in late trading and ended 100 lei weaker at 3,450.
Deals in late trading depressed Compa vehicle parts maker to a close of 2,750 lei, 950 down on the previous session.
The other fertiliser maker, Sofert, firmed 4,000 lei to 36,000.
Terapia and Antibiotice high- capitalisation pharmaceuticals pushed ahead 250 and 200 lei respectively to close at 7,650 and 7,450.

Buying pressure was also felt on the second tier, with most prices ending higher. Policolor dye maker was the most active in this section, with more than 245,000 shares in volume and 1.6 billion lei in turnover. It closed 200 lei weaker at 6,250.
